headline: Conversion dropped everywhere evenly, so no single regional cause explains it.
body: All four regions fell by nearly the same share of the decline, roughly 20% each, indicating a broad, uniform drop rather than a localized issue [E1]. Marketing spend and session volume show weak alignment with the conversion change, so neither looks like the driver [E1]. An unvalidated lead points to a North-West warehouse conveyor failure disrupting fulfillment and triggering cancellations, but this has not been corroborated with evidence yet.
what_could_change: Confirmation that the conveyor failure timeline matches the SLA breach and cancellation data would validate this lead.
caveats: Evidence coverage is empty and no hypotheses were scored, so this conclusion rests only on the uniformity pattern.
clarifying_question: Can you provide fulfillment SLA breach and cancellation data by region for June-July to test the warehouse-failure lead?
escalation_brief: Marketing conversion fell uniformly across all regions in July with no validated driver; investigate a suspected North-West warehouse conveyor failure linked to fulfillment delays and customer churn before reallocating campaign budget.
